text: New York Fed President John Williams signaled room for further rate cuts, positioning policy as still modestly restrictive and tilting near-term expectations toward additional easing. His comments reversed prior-day hawkish sentiment, lowered yields, and flipped December rate-cut odds, revealing internal Fed divergence while reestablishing continuity after the 11/20 inversion event.
